record.original_question: Let μ be a non-negative Borel measure on R^3 with total charge μ(R^3) ≤ 1, and let f: R^3 → R^3 be a contraction for the Euclidean norm. Write f_*μ for the pushforward of μ under f, so f_*μ represents a version of the same charge distribution moved closer together by the contraction. If λ1(D0 - ν * |x|^{-1}) denotes the lowest eigenvalue in the spectral gap (-1, 1) of the Dirac-Coulomb operator generated by a charge distribution ν, does every Euclidean contraction fail to increase this eigenvalue, i.e. does λ1(D0 - μ * |x|^{-1}) ≥ λ1(D0 - (f_*μ) * |x|^{-1}) always hold?

evidence.quote: Note that the numerical simulations seem to indicate that λ1 decreases when the Euclidean distance between nuclear charges is decreased, a property proved by Lieb and Simon [27, 25] in the non-relativistic case. This leads to a third conjecture:

Conjecture 3 (Monotonicity). Let μ be a non-negative Borel measure such that μ(R^3) ≤ 1 and let f : R^3 → R^3 be a contraction for the Euclidean norm of R^3. Then, denoting by f_*μ the pushforward of μ by f, we have λ1(D0 - μ * 1/|x|) ≥ λ1(D0 - (f_*μ) * 1/|x|).

artifact.status_search_result: The statement is posed as a conjecture (monotonicity under Euclidean contractions for the lowest Dirac-Coulomb eigenvalue with sub-probability charge distributions). It is the relativistic analogue of a non-relativistic result of Lieb–Simon. Available sources discuss it as an open conjecture; no proof or disproof has been located. The principal obstacle is that the lowest gap eigenvalue is characterized by a min-max rather than a minimum, so the standard Lieb–Simon argument does not transfer.

status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open conjecture, motivated by numerics and the non-relativistic Lieb–Simon result.

status_evidence.title: Dirac–Coulomb operators with general charge distribution II. The lowest eigenvalue
status_evidence.snippet: Study of the lowest eigenvalue in the gap (-1,1) for Dirac-Coulomb operators with general charge distributions, defined by min-max.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework for λ1 used in the conjecture; monotonicity under contraction is not established here.
